    engine.runAndWait()

import speech_recognition as sr
import pyttsx3

# Initialize speech recognition and text-to-speech engines
r = sr.Recognizer()
engine = pyttsx3.init()

# Define voice commands and corresponding actions
commands = {
    "turn on lights": lambda: print("Lights turned on"),
    "turn off lights": lambda: print("Lights turned off"),
    "increase temperature": lambda: print("Temperature increased"),
    "decrease temperature": lambda: print("Temperature decreased"),
    "activate security system": lambda: print("Security system activated"),
    "deactivate security system": lambda: print("Security system deactivated")
}

def listen_and_execute():
    try:
        with sr.Microphone() as source:
            print("Say something!")
            audio = r.listen(source)

        # Speech recognition
        try:
            text = r.recognize_google(audio)
            print(f"You said: {text}")

            # Execute command if recognized
            if text in commands:
                commands[text]()
                engine.say(f"Command executed: {text}")
                engine.runAndWait()

        except sr.UnknownValueError:
            print("Could not understand audio")
        except sr.RequestError as e:
            print(f"Could not request results from Google Speech Recognition service; {e}")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error occurred: {e}")

# Continuously listen for commands
while True:
    listen_and_execute()

    engine.say(text)
    engine.runAndWait()

# Define a function to listen for voice commands

        print("Listening...")
        audio = r.listen(source)

        text = r.recognize_google(audio)
        print(f"You said: {text}")
        return text
    except sr.UnknownValueError:
        print("Could not understand audio")
        return None
    except sr.RequestError as e:
        print(f"Could not request results from Google Speech Recognition service; {e}")
        return None

# Define a function to handle smart home commands

    if "lights on" in command:
        speak("Turning on lights")
        # Replace with actual code to turn on lights
    elif "lights off" in command:
        speak("Turning off lights")
        # Replace with actual code to turn off lights

        speak("Increasing temperature")
        # Replace with actual code to increase thermostat temperature
    elif "cooler" in command:
        speak("Decreasing temperature")
        # Replace with actual code to decrease thermostat temperature
    elif "security on" in command:
        speak("Activating security system")
        # Replace with actual code to activate security system
    elif "security off" in command:
        speak("Deactivating security system")
        # Replace with actual code to deactivate security system

        speak("Invalid command")

# Main loop for listening and processing voice commands
